svg.title: Receipt, execution, commit and final release differ
svg.desc: Constructed single-clock microseconds • producer-authorized reuse requires final-release evidence
svg.text: Receipt, execution, commit and final release differ
Constructed single-clock microseconds • producer-authorized reuse requires final-release evidence
One immutable slot, generation 7
Publish 5 → accept 8
Device final access 20; host final reader 24
Matching final-release ack observed 27
Earliest producer-authorized reuse = 27
Acceptance at 8 does not release readers
Old generation-6 ack cannot release 7
Duplicate ack cannot release twice
Eight slots: only two initially Free
Free 2; Producer-owned 1; Published 2
Consumer-reading 1; Retiring 2
8 × 1024 = 8192 payload bytes
Worker loss requires reconciliation
Timeout / disconnect ≠ proof of no effects
Epoch rejects stale identity, not live access
Unknown users stay retained or quarantined
Saving two 4.096-µs copies loses if replacement coordination costs 10 µs.
A transport optimization is useful only through correct complete service and bounded state.
